title: Insight lab: nothing strong this week
why: Saturday run, 14 Nov 2026: a fourth independent sample of 211 scored homepages (no overlap with the 26 Oct, 31 Oct and 7 Nov frames). Nothing new is strong enough to publish. The one finding that holds up replicates the pending W44 WordPress schema cards.
body:
RESULT: no new content this week.

REPLICATION FOR THE PENDING W44 CARDS (medium as a fact, not a separate post):
Half of Webflow homepages fail the Organization/WebSite schema check (38 of 74) against 5% of WordPress homepages (20 of 398), pooled over four samples, 26 Oct to 14 Nov 2026. Each sample alone: Webflow 61%, 45%, 40%, 57%; WordPress 5%, 7%, 7%, 1%. It holds inside SaaS, agency and professional-services sites. The total score gap is smaller (Webflow 4.9 points below WordPress, 95% interval 2.1 to 7.9) because Webflow sites lose fewer points on crawler access. Mechanism is a guess: WordPress SEO plugins appear to add this schema by default; we did not check settings. If the W44 cards go ahead, they can cite four samples and add a Webflow step: add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD in site-wide custom code.

DISCARDED:
1. Professional-services homepages score lower: -2.9 this week, interval spans zero; -2.3, -0.3, -7.6 in the earlier samples. Gap under 5 points; size swings with the frame.
2. llms.txt follows the builder: Wix 23 of 24, Squarespace 2 of 19, pooled. Both under 30; needs a targeted builder frame.
3. llms.txt adoption rising, Cloudflare managed robots.txt falling: different frames each week, so not a time series.
4. Pillar correlation, crawler access as the biggest fix, the top-5% profile, Bytespider as most blocked: same artifacts or repeats as earlier runs.

REPLICATION: Next.js ties WordPress for the fourth time. The 31 Oct correction still stands.

METHOD: 234 domains found by web search, not random, so likely more SEO-active than average; 211 scored on 14 Nov 2026, homepage only, one scan each, from a data-center address. The SaaS pass is about 70% developer tools, and the search budget cut the professional-services pass to 67 domains. Readiness only.
